questions.explain: The client runs on the flight controller, the agent on the companion/PC.

questions.q: Which message must be streamed before switching to Offboard?
questions.explain: Otherwise PX4 won't switch or arm in Offboard.

questions.q: At what OffboardControlMode rate does PX4 exit Offboard?
questions.explain: The timeout protects against a companion that has gone quiet.

questions.q: What matters about the px4_msgs branch?
options: It must match the PX4 version
questions.explain: Otherwise the message definitions don't match.

questions.q: What are the topics coming from PX4 called in ROS 2?
questions.explain: The ones going into PX4 are /fmu/in/*.

questions.q: An altitude of 3 m in TrajectorySetpoint (NED) is Z = …

questions.explain: NED: the Z axis points down.

questions.q: What QoS does a subscriber to /fmu/out/* need?
questions.explain: A QoS mismatch = the topic “stays silent”.
